The present technology relates to robotic systems featuring multi-gripper assemblies designed to selectively grip and hold objects. These assemblies utilize addressable vacuum regions that independently draw in air to secure target objects via vacuum pressure, enabling the system to pick up single or multiple objects simultaneously or sequentially. 

The robotic system includes a transport robot, an imaging system, a vision sensor device, a force detector assembly, and a processing unit (PU). The imaging system and vision sensors capture image data to identify target objects within a group and determine their positions. The PU analyzes this data to select the appropriate vacuum regions and generate commands for the robotic arm to grip and transport the objects. A registration data store (RDS) maintains physical characteristics and templates of known packages to aid in identification and can dynamically update with new information.

The end effector's gripper assembly consists of multiple vacuum grippers, manifolds, suction elements, and a compressible sealing member. The vacuum level and airflow rate can be dynamically adjusted based on the object's size, weight, and contact area to ensure a secure grip without damaging the packaging. 

Operationally, the system scans designated pickup and drop-off areas to identify target objects and calculate a base motion plan. During execution, the force detector assembly and vision sensors continuously monitor the grip's strength and the object's position. If the measured grip falls below a predetermined threshold, the system can deviate from the plan to regrip the object. If regripping attempts exceed an iteration threshold, the system may halt, notify an operator, or execute a controlled drop.

This study used the Multiphase Optimization Strategy (MOST) framework to optimize a mobile health platform for childhood sleep promotion. Ninety-seven children aged 9-12 with insufficient sleep were randomized to test combinations of five intervention components: sleep goal, child-directed and caregiver-directed loss-framed financial incentives, screen time reduction messaging, and daily routine messaging. The objective was to identify component combinations that increased weeknight sleep duration by at least 30 minutes. While no single component achieved this target, two combinations succeeded. The most effective combination included a caregiver-directed loss-framed incentive, screen time reduction messaging, and daily routine messaging, which increased sleep by an average of 39.6 minutes during the intervention. The next step is a randomized controlled trial to evaluate the optimized intervention package.

Deontic argumentation evaluates whether actions are obligatory or permitted, but struggles with weak permission, where an action is permitted if the opposite obligation is not derivable. Existing argumentation semantics, such as grounded and stable semantics, fail to support weak permissions when deontic conflicts exist. To address this, the authors propose a new argumentation semantics (wp-semantics) based on Defeasible Logic. The paper introduces a Deontic Argumentation Theory consisting of facts and rules to construct arguments, including "imaginary arguments" for weak permissions. The authors formally prove that grounded and stable semantics cannot justify weak permissions in conflictual theories. The proposed wp-semantics distinguishes between natural and imaginary arguments, defining conditions for arguments to be wp-acceptable or wp-rejected. The wp-semantics is proven to be unique, conflict-free, and ensures no argument is both justified and rejected. Crucially, it successfully characterizes weak permission even with unresolved conflicts, thereby extending grounded semantics.

This study uses molecular dynamics simulations to investigate nanoindentation in single-crystalline α-titanium, coupling atomistic modeling with orientation-resolved Schmid factor mapping. Simulations were performed on three crystallographic orientations—[0001], [10̅10], and [2̅110]—at temperatures of 10 K, 300 K, and 600 K. 

Load-displacement analysis revealed that the [0001] orientation exhibits distinct pop-in events and the lowest elastic recovery, while prismatic orientations show smoother plasticity onset. Contact pressure decreased with increasing temperature across all orientations due to enhanced atomic mobility. At low temperatures, stress-driven HCP-to-BCC phase transformations were observed, particularly in the [0001] and [10̅10] orientations. 

Basal a-type dislocations dominated plastic deformation across all conditions, while pyramidal <c+a> slip became more active at higher temperatures. Schmid factor mapping and shear strain analysis confirmed that slip activation correlates with regions of high resolved shear stress. Surface morphology varied by orientation: [0001] formed circular pile-ups, [10̅10] exhibited a dual-lobe pattern via a "lasso" mechanism, and [2̅110] displayed asymmetric pile-ups. Higher temperatures resulted in more diffuse deformation and reduced residual topography due to thermal recovery. 

Dislocation density was consistently highest in the [0001] orientation and increased with temperature, whereas prismatic orientations showed lower densities that decreased at higher temperatures due to enhanced annihilation. The findings provide a mechanistic framework for temperature-sensitive deformation in titanium, aligning with experimental observations.

This disclosure details physical layer preamble designs and signaling for wireless communication, specifically supporting IEEE 802.11be and future protocols. It introduces a universal signal field (U-SIG) followed by a version-specific Extremely High Throughput signal field (EHT-SIG) within a protocol data unit (PPDU). The U-SIG includes version-independent fields (e.g., version identifier, UL/DL, BSS color) and version-dependent fields (e.g., PPDU format, bandwidth, and punctured channel information). The EHT-SIG conveys scheduling and resource allocation details, such as resource unit (RU) assignments and modulation coding schemes. The passage outlines how different PPDU formats—trigger-based (TB), single-user (SU), multi-user (MU), and a unified SU/MU format—determine the structure and content of these signal fields. It also describes various options for indicating PPDU bandwidth and channel puncturing, including bitmaps and lookup tables, and discusses modifications to the Spatial Reuse (SR) field for newer wireless standards.

The present invention relates to a system and method for processing mobile payments when disconnected from payment servers. A user device enabled for offline mode communicates with a merchant payment system via a local network to conduct offline transactions. To prevent overdrawing, only one user device per e-wallet can be enabled for offline mode at a time, and this mode can be transferred locally between devices. When network connectivity is restored, either the user device or the merchant payment system provides the offline transaction information to the payment server. The payment server processes the transaction, using transaction IDs to prevent duplicate processing, by debiting the payer's account and crediting the merchant's account.

The High Post Split Offense is a simple, versatile basketball strategy using a 2-3 high alignment, high post splits, down screens, and back cuts. This disclosure details a tonneau cover for pickup truck beds, continuing from prior patent applications. The latching assembly uses interconnected pinch latch mechanisms on each side of a panel, allowing both latches to release when one handle is pinched, with springs biasing them back to a latched condition. Additional features include integrated lights in the pinch handles, a gusset assembly to hold panels upright when stowed, and a buckle system to secure folded panels. The cover attaches to the truck bed via adjustable side rails with clips and brackets, utilizing seals to prevent water intrusion.

The passage describes methods for manufacturing semiconductor devices, specifically multi-chip modules (MCMs) and multi-die integrated fan-out (InFO) packages, designed to address coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) mismatch issues. A reconstructed wafer is formed by arranging tested, known-good interconnect structures on a carrier substrate, encapsulating them, and thinning the encapsulant to expose external connectors. Packaged semiconductor devices, such as processor dies and memory cubes, are then bonded to the interconnect structures using Cu-to-Cu or solder bonding. Underfill and a second encapsulant are applied to protect the components. The carrier substrate is subsequently de-bonded, and external contacts are formed for connecting to external devices like printed circuit boards. 

The passage also details embodiments utilizing a single universal interconnect structure shared by multiple semiconductor devices, along with the formation of universal redistribution layers (URDLs). By employing low-temperature bonding and matching the CTE of the package to that of a printed circuit board (PCB), the method minimizes stress, delamination, and reliability issues. These super large package components (e.g., >70 mm by 70 mm) are designed to support high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI) applications, providing high data rates, large bandwidths, low latency, and simplified process flows.

Paula Norrell sued Waste Away Group, Inc. for gender discrimination under Title VII, alleging failure to promote and disparate impact. Norrell, an employee since 1996, applied for the district sales manager position when Waste Away combined its Montgomery and Opelika districts. Waste Away promoted Terry White, who had previously held the exact combined district position, and offered Norrell a different, lower-paying role, which she declined before leaving the company.

Applying the McDonnell Douglas framework, the court found Norrell established a prima facie case of failure to promote. Waste Away provided a legitimate, non-discriminatory reason, citing White's superior qualifications, including prior experience in the specific role and broader market knowledge. Norrell failed to prove this reason was a pretext for discrimination. The court determined that alleged discriminatory remarks by her supervisors were stray remarks unrelated to the promotion decision, and the actual decisionmakers independently evaluated the candidates. Additionally, Norrell abandoned her disparate impact claim. Consequently, the court granted Waste Away's Motion for Summary Judgment on all claims.

Bollinger Bands, developed by John Bollinger in the 1980s, are technical indicators used to analyze asset volatility and trend changes. They consist of a central moving average with standard deviations plotted above and below. While robust, they have disadvantages, including false signals, ineffectiveness in range-bound markets, signal delays, and sensitivity to settings. Alone, they do not guarantee a profitable system and require backtesting and defined trading rules. TradingView allows users to set up and develop Bollinger Bands strategies, such as breakouts, using Pine Script. Testing these strategies on different time frames can yield returns, though drawdowns may occur. Ultimately, Bollinger Bands provide valuable information for various trading strategies.

The TPS7H500x-SP series is a family of radiation-hardness-assured, current-mode PWM controllers optimized for Si and GaN-based DC-DC converters in space applications. The series includes the full-featured dual-output TPS7H5001-SP, single-output TPS7H5002-SP and TPS7H5003-SP for buck and isolated topologies, and dual-output TPS7H5004-SP for push-pull and full-bridge topologies. All devices feature a 0.613-V voltage reference, configurable switching frequencies from 100 kHz to 2 MHz, and an input voltage range of 4 V to 14 V.

The controllers support internal, external synchronization, and primary-secondary oscillator modes. They offer programmable dead time, leading edge blank time, and maximum duty cycles, alongside synchronous rectifier outputs. Protection and control features include peak current mode control, cycle-by-cycle current limiting, hiccup mode, external fault protection, slope compensation, pulse skipping, and thermal shutdown. The document details an application example for a synchronous push-pull converter, providing calculations for component selection—such as the transformer, FETs, output filter, and compensation network—and outlines PCB layout guidelines to ensure reliability and minimize noise.

Jane Goodall, who died at age 91, assembled a unique collection of chimpanzee skeletons from Tanzania’s Gombe National Park. Because these chimps had documented life histories, the skeletons allowed researchers to study how development influences bone structure, offering insights impossible with ancient hominid fossils. Goodall collected the remains to avoid wasting anything in the field. One notable skeleton, a matriarch named Flo, revealed that bone size does not reliably indicate body weight and showed bone loss patterns unlike human osteoporosis. Her collection continues to provide scientific value.

Developed by William J. O'Neil, a follow-through day (FTD) is a market-timing concept used to identify a new uptrend after a market correction. A rally attempt begins when a major index closes higher (Day 1); Days 2 and 3 must not fall below Day 1's low. On Day 4 or later, an FTD occurs when a major index closes significantly higher with increased volume, signaling an end to selling and a green light to buy stocks. 

While no bull market has started without an FTD since the early 1900s, the signal can fail if the index makes a new low. Backtesting the FTD strategy on the S&P 500 yielded poor short-term results due to market mean reversion, though adding an RSI filter slightly improved outcomes. The creator focused on individual stocks rather than indices. Ultimately, an FTD indicates sufficient momentum to re-enter the market, helping investors start new positions ahead of broader economic recoveries.

The double top is a bearish reversal chart pattern featuring two swing highs at the same resistance level and a neckline support between them. A break below the neckline signals a downward reversal, prompting traders to close longs or open shorts. Profit targets are projected from the neckline based on the pattern's height. Coding the pattern is difficult, and backtesting relies on Thomas Bulkowski's manual research, which found only 39% of formations reach their target. The authors note that shorting stocks with this strategy is challenging due to the market's general upward tailwind.

This systematic review and meta-analysis assessed the seroprevalence of Chikungunya in Ethiopia. Following PRISMA guidelines, five observational studies published between 2016 and 2023 were included. The pooled seroprevalence was 12.35%, with the highest prevalence in the SNNPR region (43.6%) and the lowest in Dire Dawa (12%). Seroprevalence varied by geographical location, occupation, age, sex, and education. Farmers and adults generally showed higher infection rates, while gender results were inconsistent. Meta-analysis revealed significant heterogeneity among studies, largely influenced by the diagnostic test type (ELISA vs. RT-qPCR), but no publication bias. The study concludes that Chikungunya remains a persistent public health concern in Ethiopia and recommends proactive operational readiness and public awareness campaigns.

This passage outlines the value of patterns and reusable components in building reliable distributed systems, drawing parallels to past software development advancements like algorithms and object-oriented programming. It details single-node container patterns, where tightly coupled containers share resources on one machine: the sidecar pattern (augmenting applications with features like HTTPS or configuration synchronization), the ambassador pattern (brokering external interactions like sharding or service discovery), and the adapter pattern (standardizing heterogeneous interfaces for monitoring, logging, and health checks). The text then introduces multi-node distributed patterns, contrasting monolithic systems with microservices. It explores replicated load-balanced services for stateless applications, including the use of caching, rate limiting, and SSL termination layers, and concludes by introducing sharded services for managing large-scale stateful data.

The Piotroski F-Score, developed by Joseph Piotroski, is a stock selection method evaluating 9 financial criteria to identify undervalued stocks with strong fundamentals. Stocks scoring 8 or 9 indicate strong financials. While useful for value and growth investing, it is not a guarantee of success and should be combined with other research. Backtests by Alpha Architect on NYSE stocks (1974-2014) showed the F-Score outperformed the S&P 500, yielding higher returns, particularly among cheap stocks. Additional tests were conducted by ValueSignals on European stocks and Alexander Eriksen on Scandinavian stocks. Implementing the strategy involves calculating scores, researching, diversifying, and monitoring to reduce risk.

Patrick McCaffery, a four-star basketball recruit and son of Iowa head coach Fran McCaffery, has committed to play for the Iowa Hawkeyes. Ranked as high as 30th nationally, the 6-foot-8 forward chose Iowa to play for his father and alongside his brother, Connor. He cited his father's coaching style, which allows players to play through mistakes, and Iowa's fast-paced offense as key factors. McCaffery is Iowa's first 2019 commit and is actively recruiting other prospects to join him. Currently playing for Iowa City West High School, he is focusing on adding weight and strength to prepare for the physicality of the Big Ten.

Supreme Court justices appeared willing to allow trial judges to limit attorney-client discussions about testimony during overnight recesses. The case involves David Villarreal, whose lawyer was barred from discussing his testimony overnight during his murder trial. Villarreal’s attorney argued this restriction chills necessary counsel because the line between trial strategy and testimony is unclear. However, several justices suggested a line could be drawn. Texas proposed banning "management" of testimony while allowing indirect strategy discussions, whereas the federal government advocated for a complete ban on discussing the testimony itself.

The passage discusses container design patterns for single-node and multi-node distributed systems. Containerization establishes boundaries for resource isolation, team ownership, and separation of concerns. 

Single-node patterns group tightly coupled containers on one machine:
- Sidecar: Augments an application container (e.g., adding HTTPS, configuration synchronization, monitoring) without modifying it, promoting modularity and reuse.
- Ambassador: Brokers communication between the application and external services (e.g., sharding, service brokering, request splitting).
- Adapter: Standardizes an application's interface (e.g., monitoring, logging, health checks) for external consumption.

Multi-node patterns build loosely coupled distributed systems using microservices:
- Replicated load-balanced services: Stateless services scaled horizontally for redundancy and capacity, often using readiness probes, caching layers, and SSL termination.
- Sharded services: Stateful services partitioned across multiple machines to handle large data sizes. They rely on sharding functions (using deterministic and uniform hashing) and consistent hashing to minimize disruption when scaling.

The lecture proves a lower bound for the static predecessor problem with polynomial space, showing that Van Emde Boas and fusion tree upper bounds are optimal up to a log log w factor. The proof uses communication complexity, where Alice represents the query algorithm and Bob represents the data structure, with communication rounds corresponding to memory reads. The lower bound is established for the easier "colored predecessor problem" using a technique called round elimination. By alternating message eliminations between Alice and Bob—which reduce the word size w and problem size n, respectively—the lecture derives a symmetric lower bound of omega min(log base a of w, log base b of n). A historical survey of predecessor lower bounds is also provided.

The report covers the narrative down to the January 17, 1893 revolution, with subsequent events detailed in a February 15, 1893 report. It includes a chronological list of papers, a subject index, and a bibliography of historical texts and congressional documents. Middlesbrough striker Rudy Gestede urges his team to believe they can avoid relegation ahead of their match against Arsenal. Middlesbrough is 19th and six points from safety, while sixth-placed Arsenal is coming off a recent defeat.

The NVIDIA Ampere GA10x GPU architecture, featuring the GA102 and GA104, improves upon the Turing architecture, delivering up to 1.7x faster raster graphics and 2x faster ray tracing. The GA102 GPU includes 28.3 billion transistors, 10,752 CUDA cores, 84 second-generation RT Cores, and 336 third-generation Tensor Cores, powering the GeForce RTX 3090, RTX 3080, RTX A6000, and A40 GPUs. 

Key architectural enhancements include doubling FP32 throughput by enabling FP32 processing on both SM datapaths. Second-generation RT Cores double ray-triangle intersection testing rates and allow concurrent execution of RT and compute or graphics workloads. Third-generation Tensor Cores support new data types, TF32 precision, and fine-grained structured sparsity, doubling throughput for AI operations. 

GA10x GPUs also feature GDDR6X or GDDR6 memory, PCIe Gen 4, and third-generation NVLink. Additional improvements include moving ROPs into Graphics Processing Clusters (GPCs) to increase total ROP count, and enlarging the L1 data cache and shared memory capacity and bandwidth.

This study evaluated SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccine responses in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) patients treated with methotrexate (MTX), abatacept, or rituximab compared to healthy controls. Rituximab-treated patients exhibited a near-total loss of anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibodies and reduced S-specific CD4+ T cells. Abatacept treatment led to reduced S-specific and neutralizing antibodies, decreased B cell class switching to IgG, and diminished production of IL-2, IFNγ, and IL-21 by S-specific CD4+ T cells. MTX-treated patients showed a lower magnitude of S-specific CD4+ T cells but no significant differences in B cell responses or antibody levels compared to controls. These findings indicate abatacept limits vaccine efficacy by impairing T cell help to B cells, supporting the temporary cessation of abatacept before vaccination when clinically manageable.

Indonesia’s sovereign wealth fund Danantara will launch at least eight waste-to-power projects by October, starting in Jakarta and expanding to 33 municipalities. Each facility will process 1,000 tonnes of waste daily to generate 15 megawatts of electricity, costing around $180 million per plant. Danantara will finance and oversee the projects, with state utility PLN purchasing the power. The initiative aims to reduce landfill reliance, cut emissions, and advance Indonesia's renewable energy goals.

MTN and four banks aim to raise a combined GH¢4.67 billion on the Ghana Stock Exchange within six months, marking a historic test for the bourse. MTN seeks GH¢3.48 billion through an IPO, while the banks require GH¢1.19 billion via rights issues to meet the Bank of Ghana’s recapitalisation deadline. Experts warn the market's capacity may be insufficient, making the timing risky and necessitating backup plans. While pension funds offer some liquidity, successful fundraising heavily relies on foreign and retail investor participation. Foreign inflows could stabilize the cedi, but future profit repatriation risks currency depreciation. Retail investors' participation will depend on the value and pricing offered by these firms.

This study evaluated the reliability, validity, and responsiveness of an Arabic translation of the Orthognathic Quality of Life Questionnaire (OQLQ) in Saudi Arabian orthognathic patients. The questionnaire was translated using forward-backward methods and pilot testing. In a cohort of 74 adult patients, the Arabic OQLQ showed excellent internal consistency (Cronbach’s α = 0.92) and good to excellent test-retest reliability. Validity was supported by correlations between OQLQ scores, subjective appearance improvements, and surgical satisfaction. Responsiveness was demonstrated by significantly lower overall OQLQ scores—indicating better quality of life—after surgery compared to before surgery. Despite limitations including small sample sizes for specific subgroups and a single-site sample, the study concludes that the Arabic OQLQ is a reliable, valid, and responsive instrument for assessing quality of life in Arabic-speaking orthognathic patients.

The Supreme Court will decide if the ex post facto clause applies to restitution under the 1996 Mandatory Victims Restitution Act. Bank robber Holsey Ellingburg argues restitution is a criminal punishment because it is imposed during sentencing, uses criminal procedures, punishes non-payment with incarceration, and serves punitive purposes. The government concedes restitution is criminal under this clause, but a court-appointed amicus argues Congress's intent is unclear. The appeal in United States v. Frank Walker was dismissed without costs.
Tradeshift raised $250 million in a Series E round led by Goldman Sachs and PSP Investments, bringing its total funding to over $400 million and its valuation to $1.1 billion.

Stephen Pearse, a former CEO and angel investor, outlines the fundamentals of launching a startup and securing venture capital. He notes that only about one in ten startups succeed, and investors seek 10x returns to make their funds profitable. To attract funding, entrepreneurs must deliver a simple, compelling pitch that starts with a hook, induces investor greed, and focuses on customer and business benefits rather than technical jargon. Pearse advises raising money before it is urgently needed, pitching to multiple venture capitalists simultaneously to create competition, and prioritizing investor reputation over equity dilution. Additional success factors include maintaining strict cash flow, being willing to pivot based on customer feedback, prioritizing speed to market over intellectual property, maintaining focus, and demonstrating strong leadership, passion, and confidence.

The speaker states the team is more comfortable in the Stanley Cup Finals after a slow start, emphasizing the need to play their own style to be successful. The team is deep, with strong lines, defense, and goaltending, supported by recent additions and committed owners. They are confident playing on the road and focused on winning the next sold-out game in Anaheim. The speaker also praises a teammate who overcame past injuries to become one of the league's best players.

This systematic review examines how student personality traits influence satisfaction and success in online higher education, a relevant topic as occupational therapy programs increasingly adopt online learning. Following PRISMA guidelines, researchers analyzed 23 Level 4 evidence studies published between 2000 and 2024. None of the included studies focused on occupational therapy. Findings indicated that conscientiousness, openness, and agreeableness generally correlated positively with academic success, satisfaction, and engagement. Conversely, neuroticism was typically negatively associated with these outcomes. Extraverts often preferred face-to-face or interactive online elements, while introverts favored online formats. The review highlights the need for educators to implement Universal Design for Learning (UDL) and support self-regulated learning to accommodate diverse personality traits. Future research should test specific interventions and include occupational therapy education to address current evidence gaps.

In 1977, Leeds hosted the UK's first Reclaim the Night march, prompted by the Yorkshire Ripper attacks and general harassment. Organized by the Leeds Revolutionary Feminist Group, women marched in 12 towns and cities to protest male violence. The marches continued until the early 1990s and were revived in 2004. This history now inspires "The Darkest Corners," a new performance by theatre company RashDash. Part of the Transform 17 festival, the show takes place in a Holbeck car park to highlight ongoing women's safety issues and celebrate 40 years of female activism.

Southwestern College adjuncts held a sparsely attended rally advocating for better wages and equal protections. Adjuncts teach 75% of classes but lack full-time benefits, often traveling between multiple colleges to survive. Speakers highlighted job insecurity, inadequate insurance, and diminished education quality due to long commutes. College President Dr. Kindred Murillo and Trustee Roberto Alcantar expressed support for the adjuncts. Organizers urged students and faculty to help adjuncts secure paid office hours and disability leave.

The NVIDIA Turing GPU architecture introduces advancements in real-time graphics, VR, and AI. It supports VirtualLink, a single USB-C connector for VR headsets, and uses NVLink to improve SLI bandwidth. Turing enables real-time ray tracing via dedicated RT Cores that accelerate Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) traversal and ray-triangle intersection, supporting a Hybrid Rendering model that combines rasterization and ray tracing. The architecture includes NGX, a deep learning stack using Tensor Cores for features like Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS), InPainting, and AI Super Rez. Turing also introduces Mesh Shading to reduce CPU bottlenecks, Variable Rate Shading (VRS) for dynamic shading control, Texture Space Shading (TSS) for decoupled shading, and Multi-View Rendering (MVR) for efficient multi-projection. These features are implemented across the TU102, TU104, and TU106 GPUs, which offer varying configurations of CUDA, Tensor, and RT Cores.
Delta Air Lines intends to acquire up to 32% more of Grupo Aeroméxico for MXP$43.59 per share pending regulatory approval, potentially raising its ownership and options to 49%.

Pika, a TikTok-like AI video app for Gen Z founded by Demi Guo and Chenlin Meng, raised $135 million. Its "Predictive Video" feature generates short videos from simple prompts and selfies. This study examines higher education students' perceptions and preferences between Online Learning (OL) and Emergency Remote Education (ERE) during the COVID-19 pandemic. OL is an intentionally planned, flexible modality, while ERE was a temporary, rapid response to the crisis. Using a survey of 88 undergraduate students at a Colombian university and the Add-on Preferential Groups (APG) model, researchers found that students positively perceived both modalities but generally preferred OL. OL was rated significantly higher in areas like content quality, assessment strategies, and independent activities. ERE was only favored for student-student interaction. Students recommended improving both modalities by enhancing instructor technological and pedagogical training, reducing student workload, and designing authentic, collaborative assessments and interaction spaces.

Mark Cuban stated that President Trump’s planned direct-to-consumer drug platform, TrumpRx.gov, could succeed if it forces pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) to change. Cuban, who founded a similar platform in 2022, graded the initiative a “B” because PBM stock prices rose post-announcement, suggesting industry skepticism. The Russell 2000 Index, a market-weighted small-cap stock index, undergoes an annual rebalancing on the fourth Friday of June to reflect market capitalization changes and maintain its intended composition. This process involves buying and selling stocks, which can create temporary market imbalances. A backtested trading strategy capitalizes on an abnormal index rally during this period by buying on the close of the first trading day after June 23rd and selling on the close of the first trading day of July. From 1988, this strategy yielded an average gain of 1.34% over six trading days, outperforming the S&P 500's 0.85%. However, hedging the Russell 2000 with a short S&P 500 position resulted in a lower average gain of 0.23%.

Digital leaders use transparent, data-driven objectives to align teams vertically and horizontally with company strategy, requiring employee buy-in rather than top-down mandates. This document outlines the statistical analysis plan for Zealand Pharma A/S protocol ZP4207-17086, a phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo- and active-controlled trial evaluating dasiglucagon versus placebo and GlucaGen® in children with type 1 diabetes mellitus. The primary objective is to demonstrate dasiglucagon's superiority over placebo in treating hypoglycemia. Secondary objectives include comparing dasiglucagon to GlucaGen® and assessing its safety and pharmacokinetic profiles.

The trial includes screening, treatment, and follow-up periods, targeting 40 patients (20 dasiglucagon, 10 placebo, 10 GlucaGen®). Statistical tests will be 2-sided at a 0.05 significance level, utilizing SAS and Phoenix WinNonlin. Analysis sets include the safety set, full analysis set (FAS), and per protocol set (PPS).

The primary efficacy endpoint, time to plasma glucose recovery (≥20 mg/dL increase), will be analyzed using Kaplan-Meier methods and a stratified log-rank test on the FAS. Secondary endpoints involve plasma glucose recovery and changes at 10, 15, 20, and 30 minutes. Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic metrics will be evaluated via non-compartmental analysis. Safety analyses will encompass exposure, local tolerability, treatment-emergent adverse events, laboratory measurements, vital signs, ECGs, and immunogenicity. The document also specifies data presentation standards, SAS programming quality control requirements, and modifications to protocol-specified analyses.

On May 1, 2018, Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing its financial results for the second fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2018. The filing included a press release and a related data sheet as exhibits, and was signed by Senior Vice President and CFO Luca Maestri.

The NVIDIA GA10x Ampere architecture introduces GDDR6X memory, utilizing PAM4 signaling and MTA encoding to achieve up to 936 GB/sec bandwidth. NVIDIA RTX IO, paired with Microsoft's DirectStorage API, offloads asset loading and lossless decompression from the CPU to the GPU, significantly improving I/O performance. The architecture features 2nd-generation RT Cores, 3rd-generation Tensor Cores with structural sparsity, and 2x FP32 throughput. It supports 5th-gen NVDEC (including AV1 hardware decode) and 7th-gen NVENC for video processing. Specific GPUs include the GeForce RTX 3090 and 3070, the data-center optimized A40, and the workstation RTX A6000. GDDR6X also introduces Error Detection and Replay (EDR) to improve overclocking stability by replaying errored memory transmissions.

Federal Judge Jack Weinstein ruled that the Freedom of Access to Clinic Entrances Act (FACEA) protects Falun Gong practitioners from harassment. The ruling responds to a lawsuit by practitioners claiming harassment by the Chinese Anti-Cult World Alliance. The alliance challenged FACEA's constitutionality via the commerce clause, but Weinstein rejected this, stating religion is deeply rooted in interstate commerce. Book banning in U.S. schools and higher education is rising, with 22,810 instances reported from 2021 to 2025. Previously limited to a few sectarian colleges, censorship is now widespread, driven by conservative movements and Trump administration policies. Military academies, public universities like Texas A&M, and institutions like New College of Florida have experienced book removals, professor dismissals, and curriculum audits. The Carter administration used MONs to introduce specific operations under approved covert action findings, requiring interagency coordination. The 1980 Intelligence Oversight Act scaled back Hughes-Ryan amendment provisions, limiting congressional oversight to the two intelligence committees, or the "Gang of Eight" in extraordinary circumstances, and clarifying that notification did not require congressional approval. In *St. Louis & San Francisco Railroad Company v. Conarty*, the court affirmed the lower court's judgment. The court upheld the validity of the prohibition against removing a case to Federal court under the Federal Employers' Liability Act. It ruled that a widow, suing as administratrix, may recover in a single action for both the pecuniary loss to the next of kin and the deceased's pain and suffering, as the right of action survives to the personal representative. Additionally, a disabled coal car consigned for interstate travel remained in use for interstate commerce under the Safety Appliance Act while being moved to a repair track. The railroad was held liable for the employee's death caused by the car's defective coupler, as the defect was the direct cause of the injury, even though the employee was not handling the coupler. Finally, the widow's testimony regarding the deceased's financial contributions was admissible because it was collateral to the main issue of liability and only pertained to the amount of damages.

The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe states the official USD to bond note exchange rate remains 1:1 and advises the public to use licensed financial institutions for exchanges. Governor Dr. John Mangudya noted that illegal money changers are being arrested under a new 2017 law. The RBZ and police will also act against retailers refusing non-cash payments. Previous black market rate distortions caused panic buying and artificial goods shortages.

The dollar reached three-week highs after New York Fed President William Dudley reinforced the commitment to interest rate hikes, boosting Treasury yields. Geopolitical risks involving Syria and North Korea supported the safe-haven yen. The euro declined due to French presidential election uncertainty. Although U.S. unemployment dropped to 4.5%, job growth missed forecasts. Speculators also reduced bullish dollar bets to a five-week low.

This work determines that Heisenberg scaling is achievable in continuous-wave interferometry for time-dependent signals using pure squeezed state inputs. The authors establish a spectral quantum Cramer-Rao bound showing that precision scales inversely with squeezing bandwidth and photon occupancy. This bound can be attained using a linearized maximum likelihood estimator that processes filtered homodyne detector records by squaring and subtracting them.

This study evaluates the prognostic value of platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), and prognostic nutritional index (PNI) in chronic hepatitis C (CHC)-associated cirrhosis patients complicated by type 2 diabetes (T2DM). Researchers included 56 CHC-cirrhosis with T2DM patients, 85 CHC-cirrhosis patients, and 85 T2DM patients from 2018 to 2021. The CHC-cirrhosis with T2DM group was divided into poor and good prognosis subgroups after six months. Blood tests were used to calculate NLR, PNI, and PLR.

The Rubber Band trading strategy is a contrarian, mean-reversion method for trading stocks that targets overbought or oversold conditions to anticipate a price return to the mean. It commonly uses indicators like Keltner Channels or Bollinger Bands. Buy setups occur when the price drops below the lower Keltner band, and sell setups occur when it rises above the upper band, with profit targets near the middle band. A backtested XLP strategy demonstrated a 6.1% CAGR and 2.0 profit factor. The strategy works primarily on stocks and relies on contrarian sentiment.

This study developed a two-stage machine learning framework using ADNI data to predict cognitive decline and dementia progression in non-demented individuals. The framework combined plasma biomarkers (Aβ42/40, p-tau 181, NfL), MRI-derived scores, demographics, APOE4, and baseline cognitive scores. Results indicated that a combined model integrating all predictors achieved the highest performance, particularly for predicting memory decline. Plasma biomarkers NfL and p-tau 181, along with MRI scores, were significant predictors for memory, executive function, and language, but not visuospatial abilities. Predicting decline was more challenging in cognitively unimpaired individuals than in those with mild cognitive impairment. Furthermore, predicted memory decline rates effectively forecasted progression to MCI or dementia. The study concludes that plasma biomarkers combined with non-invasive measures show strong potential for predicting memory decline and dementia progression, though their utility is limited in non-memory domains.

UK university staff may strike for 14 more days during the April-June exam period if talks over pension scheme changes between Universities UK and UCU fail. UCU prefers dialogue but is prepared to strike. Additionally, the University of Edinburgh is criticized for using past recorded lectures to break the strike, which UCU Scotland says lets down staff and students.

A report by the National Academy of Sciences and the National Academy of Medicine recommends allowing scientists to alter heritable human DNA solely to prevent serious, strongly heritable diseases, while keeping trait enhancement off-limits. Although germline editing is currently illegal in the U.S., advancements like CRISPR-Cas9 make it a realistic possibility. The international panel advises that clinical trials only target severe diseases lacking reasonable alternatives, undergo public scrutiny, and include long-term follow-up. Experts praised the report for initiating necessary ethical discussions alongside scientific progress.

During a week-long joint operation in Singapore, police arrested eight women for advertising sexual services and 15 men for gambling and drink-driving. Cash and phones were seized, and investigations are ongoing.

Google is adding 30 new languages, primarily in India and Africa, to its speech recognition services, bringing the total to 119. This enables voice search and typing via Gboard. The update adds emoji dictation for U.S. English, integrates with the Cloud Speech API, and will eventually reach Google Translate. Targeting emerging markets, Google developed these capabilities by using native speakers to collect speech samples to train its machine learning models.

Aiden Markram was named South Africa's cricket captain after Faf du Plessis suffered a finger injury. Markram expressed honor and readiness to handle the pressure, relying on senior players like Hashim Amla for support. Du Plessis continues to mentor him. The Proteas, trailing India 1-0 in the six-match ODI series after a Durban loss, aim to improve in Sunday's second ODI at SuperSport Park.

Agent-based modeling simulates complex systems through local interactions and emergent behavior. BioDynaMo, a state-of-the-art simulation platform, is limited to single-server shared-memory parallelism, restricting simulation size, third-party integration, and hardware flexibility. To overcome these limitations, the authors present TeraAgent, a distributed simulation engine that scales out agent-based simulations across multiple servers using spatial partitioning. TeraAgent addresses the high performance and energy overheads of distributed execution with two key improvements: a novel serialization mechanism (TeraAgent IO) that allows direct use of objects from received buffers while maintaining mutability, and a delta encoding scheme that compresses data communication by exploiting the gradual changes in agent attributes over iterations. TeraAgent supports MPI hybrid and MPI only modes, enabling seamless execution from laptops to supercomputers without code modifications. Evaluations demonstrate that TeraAgent simulates 501.51 billion agents on 84,096 CPU cores—an 84x improvement over the state-of-the-art. It achieves an 8x higher agent update rate per CPU core than Biocellion, improves visualization performance by 39x, and increases median serialization speed by 110x while reducing data transfer by up to 3.5x through delta encoding.

Saints' 2017/18 Anglo-Welsh Cup fixtures are Exeter (a, Nov 4), Dragons (h, Nov 11), Sale (a, Jan 26-28), and Harlequins (h, Feb 2-4). Teams play cross-pool matches, with pool winners reaching the semi-finals. Saints' group includes Saracens, Scarlets, and Worcester.

Soil-transmitted helminth (STH) impact assessment surveys (IAS) are costly for endemic countries. This paper proposes a model-based geostatistical (MBG) approach that utilizes baseline prevalence data, environmental risk factors, and preventive chemotherapy (PC) history to design more efficient surveys. The methodology involves fitting a geospatial model to baseline data, projecting prevalence forward using a multi-state Markov model, and evaluating sampling designs. Applied to Kenya, Sierra Leone, and Zimbabwe, the MBG approach achieved the same accuracy as classical methods but reduced survey costs by an average of 80% by drastically decreasing the required sample size. This method also produces detailed prevalence maps and could be adapted for other neglected tropical diseases.

CoreLogic reports national home prices rose 7.1% year-over-year in May 2018 and 1.1% month-over-month, driven by limited housing supply and homeowners retaining low mortgage rates. Forty percent of the top 100 metropolitan areas were overvalued. Despite high prices, strong renter demand persists. The national home-price index is projected to increase 5.1% by May 2019.

The present invention is a vehicle driver monitoring system that uses interior and exterior cameras and vehicle sensors to estimate a driver's attention. The system calculates driver attention by estimating a distraction workload and a driving workload, then subtracting their weighted sum from a maximum driver workload. Inputs include driver identity, posture, emotions, health, driving behavior, and environmental conditions. The system can also monitor passengers to refine driver distraction estimates. Processed by an electronic control unit, the system can display images, generate alerts, or autonomously control the vehicle if the driver's awareness is insufficient and risk exceeds a threshold. The system is applicable to autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicles and may incorporate V2V/V2X communication and various sensors like radar and lidar.

Alere Inc concluded its 2013-2015 financial statements should not be relied upon due to revenue recognition misstatements in South Korea and Japan. The company expects unremediated material weaknesses and may delay its Q1 2017 report.

Shonda Rhimes and her Shondaland production company signed a deal to create new shows for Netflix. Her current series will continue airing on ABC. Financial terms and the contract's length were not disclosed.

The American Academy of Pediatrics advises against routinely ordering five common tests—hormone, endocrine, vitamin D, thyroid/insulin, and thyroid ultrasounds—for otherwise healthy children who are short, overweight, or showing early puberty signs. Instead of excessive testing, doctors should reassure parents about normal growth variations. These tests should be reserved for children with specific clinical indications, such as abnormal growth rates, low bone mass, or severe thyroid enlargement.

Letters from women in immigration detention, circulated by the nonprofit Grassroots Leadership, describe poor facility conditions and the emotional distress of family separation. One anonymous woman detailed spending eight days in a Texas holding center she called "la perrera," citing a lack of hygiene and sleeping on floors. The women wrote the letters to publicly seek help for release and reunification with their children. ICE stated it could not address specific claims because the writers' names were redacted and exact facility locations were unclear. Accounts from women like Mirian, Claudia, and the anonymous Guatemalan mother highlight the anguish of separation. The anonymous woman's children were eventually released to their father, and she was released from custody on June 26.

Pairs trading is a market-neutral statistical arbitrage strategy that involves simultaneously buying and selling two highly correlated financial instruments to profit from the convergence or divergence of their price spread. Originating in the 1980s, the strategy aims to generate returns uncorrelated with the broader market. While it offers advantages like market neutrality and a high win ratio, it also carries drawbacks, including leverage risks, shorting costs, slippage, and the potential for asset pairs to wander apart. Cointegration is often preferred over correlation for selecting pairs. Backtests on pairs like KO/PEP and GS/MS showed returns lower than a buy-and-hold strategy without leverage. Although still utilized by hedge funds, the easiest profits have diminished over time, requiring diversification and fundamental analysis to remain effective.

This application describes a method, apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium for displaying a marker element in a virtual scene. A terminal renders a virtual scene and obtains marker indication information for a target virtual item marked by a user for teammates to view. A server checks if the target item is within a visible distance of the current virtual object. If so, the server transmits the marker indication information to the corresponding terminals. The terminals obtain graphic data, render a marker element, and display it around the target virtual item in the display interface. The terminals may also display distance information, such as straight-line, horizontal, or height difference, around the marker element. Marker elements can be removed after a preset duration. The application also details the terminal's hardware structure and the apparatus modules implementing this method.

Tesla Motors, Inc.'s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2016, reports total revenues of $2.30 billion, up from $936.8 million in Q3 2015, with a gross margin of 27.7%. The company designs, manufactures, and sells electric vehicles and energy products, producing approximately 25,180 vehicles in Q3 2016. Tesla targets 500,000 vehicle production in 2018 and continues expanding its manufacturing capacity, including the Gigafactory, where cell production is expected to begin in Q4 2016. In May 2016, Tesla raised approximately $1.7 billion through a public offering. The company also entered a definitive agreement to acquire SolarCity Corporation. Tesla continues to invest heavily in capital expenditures for Model 3 production, Gigafactory construction, and global retail and service expansion.

Henrik Lundqvist emphasized the need for a strong start and confidence in the upcoming game after a difficult loss. He believes his team has not been outplayed, with the difference coming down to a few key plays. Acknowledging the opponent as the best they have faced, Lundqvist stressed that winning requires their absolute best effort and some luck. 

Analyzing his performance, Lundqvist feels he is tracking the puck well and making the right reads, though giving up three or more goals makes winning difficult. He plans to focus on his process and stopping the next shot. The team is disappointed but remains focused on winning the next game. To beat the opposing goalie, Lundqvist noted the need for more traffic in front of the net and battling for loose pucks. He remains confident in a potential turnaround, starting with a strong first period.

Judges ordered the reinstatement of two professors terminated for speech. Texas State University's Thomas Alter, fired for allegedly inciting violence, will be reinstated without pay pending review. South Dakota professor Michael Hook was also ordered reinstated for online speech.

Researchers found that ALS patients have stronger immune cell responses to the protein C9orf72 than healthy individuals. Patients with anti-inflammatory responses to C9orf72 were predicted to survive longer. While these findings suggest an autoimmune component to ALS and could lead to new treatments and disease tracking methods, researchers caution it does not prove ALS is an autoimmune disease. It remains unclear if these immune responses drive ALS or are a side effect. Further studies are planned to investigate this relationship.

The S&P 500 rose 2.2% in July but declined in early August. While medium and long-term market trends remain healthy, short-term technicals show early warnings and seasonal headwinds. Investors are increasingly favoring tech stocks, and US electricity demand reached a record high. The passage also features financial news headlines and standard trading risk disclaimers.

Cryptocurrency crime is rising in Japan despite falling overall crime rates. The recent ¥58 billion theft from Coincheck Inc., which had prior security warnings, has damaged public trust. Japan is central to crypto, having legalized bitcoin in 2017, but faces a seedy side including fraud, ransomware, and Initial Coin Offering (ICO) scams. The Financial Services Agency (FSA) warns ICOs carry high fraud and volatility risks, though they remain largely unregulated in Japan. Meanwhile, Facebook has banned ICO ads, and the US SEC halted a fraudulent $600 million ICO. Japanese consumers are currently unprotected and at risk of financial loss, though a regulatory crackdown may occur soon.

The Ontario Liberals may scrap provincewide EQAO tests for Grades 3 and 9, eliminate mandatory high school literacy tests, and water down Grade 6 tests if re-elected, according to the "Ontario: A Learning Province" report. Implementation is delayed until after the June 7 election. Education Minister Indira Naidoo-Harris supports the report's proposal to transfer assessment responsibility to teachers. The author criticizes this as pandering to teachers who oppose standardized tests, arguing that objective measurement is necessary for accountability. The independent testing agency, EQAO, was not consulted and expressed disappointment over the potential loss of independent data. The report recommends against ranking schools and suggests making tests more accessible for First Nations students. The government previously denied planning to scrap these tests.

Auswide Bank, formed from Queensland building societies, aims to challenge major banks by emphasizing the "power of small." As of June 30, 2020, it reported AUD3.79 billion in assets. This case study provides 15 representative transactions for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2021, and tasks students with recording them, preparing a balance sheet, and calculating net income and cash flows. The passage also includes Auswide's 2020 financial statements.

Motivate introduced 250 electric pedal-assist Ford GoBikes in San Francisco to ease hill climbing and attract new users. The bikes, branded Ford GoBike Plus, aim to encourage longer trips and replace cars for short journeys. Currently limited to San Francisco, the rollout was coordinated with city officials, contrasting with the recent sudden arrival of rental scooters. The e-bikes join existing shared transit options in the Bay Area's Ford GoBike program.

The article presents an exploratory case study of the Washington Education Association (WEA) Teacher Residency Program, the first union-led, non-higher-education-affiliated teacher preparation program in the United States. Developed to address special education teacher shortages and workforce diversity gaps in Washington State, the program piloted an 18-month training model during the 2023–24 academic year with 16 teacher residents across three school districts. 

The study investigated the program's training components, technology integration, and resident incentives. Findings indicate the program utilizes evidence-based practices, including a Hyflex course model, the Universal Design for Learning framework, family engagement, and alignment with state standards. Residents receive support from trained mentors and instructional coaches. The program incorporates emerging technologies, such as AI-driven Mursion simulation software and various assistive and instructional tools. Incentives include a living wage, health insurance, and funded placements, with residents committing to three years of service in their host districts. Funded by state and local partnerships, the WEA program offers a model for alternative certification that emphasizes cultural competency, rigorous clinical experience, and technological integration to prepare diverse special education teachers.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Secretary Abid Majeed directed forming committees led by pediatricians to oversee the upcoming October measles campaign targeting 4.3 million children aged nine to 59 months. Chairing a preparation meeting, he emphasized staff training, logistics, communication, and referral systems for adverse effects. The campaign responds to rising measles cases across the province.

The speaker prioritizes defense, avoiding turnovers, and winning the final two games over personal records. Prior experience helps manage media attention, which is enjoyable but sometimes excessive, yet accepted as a hockey player.

IDC identifies IT-based simulations, modeling, data analytics, and High-Performance Computing (HPC) as vital for industrial enterprises to navigate disruptive changes and drive digital transformation. HPC, including cloud and HPCaaS, enables agile operations and new business models. IDC recommends enterprises establish virtual product development, create a holistic data strategy for a single source of truth across the product lifecycle, and evaluate HPC operating models based on needs like budget, security, and skills. Organizations should also prioritize scalability, security, and energy efficiency in HPC solutions, while leveraging external partners for complex implementation. These recommendations are based on a December 2021 IDC survey of 200 decision-makers from large industrial enterprises in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

Successful classical musicians Sarah and Laura Ayoub credit their fully funded Scottish music education for their careers. However, access is declining; 22 local authorities now charge for tuition, some are raising fees, and the number of music teachers has dropped significantly over the past decade. Campaigners and musicians argue that charging creates a barrier, emphasizing music's importance for children's well-being and social integration. Renfrewshire is an exception, increasing funding to ensure free access. The Scottish government highlights its Youth Music Initiative for primary schools but notes that local councils control secondary tuition budgets. Advocates stress that music education benefits students in all future professions, not just music.

Plaintiff Toy Lykins sued his union, alleging that spending his compulsory dues on non-collective-bargaining purposes violated his First Amendment rights. The court denied defendants' summary judgment motion, holding that a justiciable controversy existed, plaintiff was not required to exhaust administrative remedies or attend union meetings, and the NLRA's authorization of union shop clauses constitutes sufficient governmental action to support a First Amendment challenge. The court concluded that the NLRA does not authorize unions to spend dissenters' dues on political or ideological causes, and ordered further proceedings.

A Gallup-Walton Family Foundation survey of U.S. public school teachers found that over 25% lack basic materials and staffing, significantly impacting job satisfaction. Two-thirds of educators report shortages of teaching assistants, paraprofessionals, and mental health resources. While 72% have adequate equipment, many lack furniture, laptops, and printing supplies, with 1 in 3 finding the ordering process difficult. Job satisfaction is 77% for teachers with adequate resources versus 44% without. Staffing and furniture shortages affect both wealthy and low-income schools similarly, though low-income schools face greater technology deficits. Additionally, half of teachers feel professional development is disconnected from student needs, noting that the most valuable methods, like peer observation and collaborative planning, are often unavailable. Teachers frequently use personal funds or crowdfunding to compensate for material deficits.
The speaker enjoys being in Detroit, winning the Stanley Cup, and hopes to return. They respect the coach's career and enjoy the experience more the second time.

This lecture focuses on implementing causal linear shift-invariant systems, represented by linear constant coefficient difference equations, through digital networks. Implementation relies on three operations: delay, multiplication, and addition. These are graphically represented using block diagrams or signal flow graphs. In a signal flow graph, nodes connect via directed branches, and node variables equal the sum of entering branch outputs. For these systems, linear signal flow graphs use branch transmittances that are scalars or functions of z, such as z^-1 for delays.

The signal flow graph corresponds to a set of linear equations expressible in matrix form. This representation separates non-delay coefficient matrices from delay matrices, decomposing an n-th order difference equation into coupled first-order difference equations. A network's computability depends on node numbering; it is computable if nodes can be ordered so the coefficient matrix has no non-zero elements on or above the main diagonal. Delay-free loops cause non-computability, preventing sequential node calculation, though the equations remain solvable.

Ron Washington will not return as the Los Angeles Angels' manager in 2026. General manager Perry Minasian told Washington the decision was based on team performance, not his health, after Washington missed half the 2025 season following quadruple bypass surgery. Interim manager Ray Montgomery will also not return. The Angels finished 72-90, last in the AL West, and are seeking their sixth manager in nine years. Washington, who was 99-137 in two seasons, wishes to continue managing or coaching. Albert Pujols and Torii Hunter are considered candidates for the managerial position.

Britain declared the occupation of the Sandwich Islands unauthorized and promised an inquiry. The incident stemmed from complex causes: American influence predominated in Hawaii, hampering England and France's competition for supremacy. France introduced a rival religion, while Britain hoped this would diminish American influence. Native sentiment favored the United States, which had shown goodwill and respect, with Captain Jones's treaty being the first recognition of Hawaiian autonomy.

Hawaii's first embassy, comprising William Richards and Timoteo Haalilio, sought recognition of independence. In December 1842, Mr. Webster recognized Hawaiian independence on behalf of the President, declaring no foreign interference should be countenanced. This was later confirmed by Mr. Calhoun.

In November 1843, the ambassadors secured a convention between France and Britain, engaging them to consider the Sandwich Islands an independent state and never take possession of its territory. However, this convention didn't guarantee autonomy against third powers or contain expressions similar to Webster's declaration.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on the 7nm Ampere architecture, accelerates AI, HPC, and data analytics workloads. It features third-generation Tensor Cores supporting FP16, BF16, TF32, FP64, INT8, INT4, and Binary formats, delivering significant speedups over the V100. A100 introduces Fine-Grained Structured Sparsity, using a 2:4 sparse matrix definition to double compute throughput. Hardware enhancements include 40GB of HBM2 memory, a 40MB L2 cache, L2 residency controls, and Compute Data Compression. The Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) capability securely partitions a single A100 into up to seven isolated instances with independent memory paths. Additional features include third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, asynchronous copy and barrier instructions, and Task Graph acceleration to improve multi-GPU scalability and programmability.
After losing 2-0 to Spurs, Manchester United hosts Huddersfield Town to strengthen their top-four position. Manager Jose Mourinho will also address Marouane Fellaini's fitness and Paul Pogba issues.

JSTE aims to use NGTE to influence Japan's next national curriculum revision, highlighting a collaborative process between academic societies and government bodies, with future tasks including practical implementation and teacher education reform.

A state audit found former Duquesne superintendent Barbara McDonnell and four employees took unapproved personal loans from district funds. Auditor General DePasquale also cited undocumented transportation reimbursements and referred the matter to the State Ethics Commission.

The Port Hardy Secondary School Senior Girls soccer team placed second at the Island Championships, qualifying for the BC Single A High School Provincials in Penticton. They won their first match 6-1, lost to Glenlyon Norfolk 5-4, and won the semi-final 3-1 in overtime against St. Andrews. “Lobster 207,” or the Maine Lobstering Union (MLU), was formed in 2013 as both a local lodge of the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers (IAM) and a cooperative business. It organized self-employed Maine lobstermen who faced depressed prices, regulatory pressures, and industry consolidation. IAM representatives Dave "Sully" Sullivan and Joel Pitcher led the non-traditional organizing campaign, as there was no employer to bargain with. 

Lobster 207 first achieved political victories by influencing legislation and regulations in Maine. To address economic pressures, the group formed a statewide marketing co-op, which exempted them from anti-trust restrictions and allowed them to act as price-setters. In 2017, with financing from the IAM and the Bank of Labor, the co-op purchased a wholesale lobster business to capture more value from the supply chain. By combining political advocacy with economic ownership, Lobster 207 increased its membership and improved lobster prices, raising questions about the future of organizing independent workers.

Baker noted that returning to the Ochotsk Sea from Vladivostok on October 1st after rugged weather began would be useless. The lecture discusses capabilities as a method for privilege separation, focusing on the "confused deputy" problem and the Capsicum sandboxing system. The confused deputy problem arises when a program with multiple privileges, such as a Fortran compiler, implicitly uses all available privileges, allowing users to trick it into unauthorized actions. This issue stems from ambient authority, where operations are permitted based on implicit process properties like Unix user IDs.

Capabilities address this by requiring explicit, unforgeable references—similar to Unix file descriptors—to access objects, thereby eliminating ambient authority. The Capsicum system applies this concept to sandbox application components, limiting potential damage from compromised code in programs like tcpdump and gzip. Capsicum requires kernel modifications to eliminate global namespaces, such as file paths, process IDs, and network addresses, once a process enters capability mode. In this mode, all operations must use existing file descriptors. The `lch_start` library function helps cleanly start sandboxes by restricting inherited file descriptors and memory. While Capsicum provides developers a tool to build more secure applications, its effectiveness depends on correct implementation, appropriate privilege assignment, and a bug-free kernel.

Joel Greenblatt's Magic Formula strategy, popularized in *The Little Book That Beats the Market*, selects stocks by ranking them on two metrics: return on invested capital (ROIC) and earnings yield (EY). Investors rank a universe of stocks based on these metrics, sum the ranks, and select the top 30-50 stocks with the lowest combined values. The strategy aims to identify undervalued companies with strong financials for long-term returns. Backtests by Greenblatt (1988-2004) and others showed the strategy outperforming the S&P 500 and performing well in Nordic markets. However, it faces criticism and risks, including a lack of qualitative factor consideration, small-cap bias, transaction costs, potential sector concentration, and a period of underperformance from 2014 onward. Performance is typically evaluated using total returns, alpha, and volatility.

The National Weather Service Burlington VT issued a zone forecast for Northern New York on March 19, 2018. The forecast predicts sunny and clear conditions for Monday and Tuesday across regions including Clinton, St. Lawrence, Franklin, and Essex counties, with highs in the 20s to lower 30s and lows in the single digits to mid-teens. Wednesday through Sunday will see partly sunny days and partly cloudy nights, with highs warming into the 30s and lows mostly in the 20s. Roundhill Investments relaunched its actively managed meme stock ETF under the ticker MEME. The previous fund launched in late 2021 near a market peak and closed two years later. Experts warn the relaunch signals market exuberance. The new fund features newer meme and quantum computing stocks, and fell over 2% on its first day.

The lecture explains the design of digital low-pass Infinite Impulse Response (IIR) filters by mapping analog Butterworth filters using impulse invariance and bilinear transformation. Analog Butterworth filters are characterized by a monotonic frequency response, a cutoff frequency, and an order parameter, with poles distributed on a circle in the s-plane. For a digital filter with a passband edge at 0.2π and a stopband edge at 0.3π, both design methods require a 6th-order filter. Impulse invariance maps frequencies linearly but risks aliasing, requiring stopband specifications to be exceeded. The bilinear transformation uses frequency pre-warping, avoids aliasing, and achieves better high-frequency attenuation. In both methods, the sampling parameter T is irrelevant. These lowpass design techniques can be generalized to other filter types via frequency transformations.

Thokozani Khupe was elected leader of a breakaway MDC faction, criticizing male rivals as cowardly and accusing Nelson Chamisa of hijacking the party. Various officials were elected to her faction's leadership, including spokesperson Linda Masarira. Khupe defended Masarira's appointment against internal backlash, highlighting the party's 50-50 gender representation. Khupe's faction refuses to recognize Chamisa as leader following Morgan Tsvangirai's death. Chamisa sought a High Court interdict to stop Khupe from using the MDC name. The court's judgment is pending, and the electoral commission requires such disputes resolved before nomination day.

Walmart will let US employees with 90 days of tenure earn a business or supply chain degree for $1 a day, covering remaining tuition, fees, and books. Partnered with Guild Education, the program replaces a previous discount and includes coaching and work-training credits. This move increases competition for workers in a tight job market, mirroring recent tuition benefits from McDonald's and Starbucks.

Defensive ends (DEs) are highly prioritized, well-paid athletes tasked with disrupting opposing offenses and slowing down passing attacks. Lining up on the "end" of the line of scrimmage, they are responsible for both run defense—maintaining gap integrity—and pressuring the quarterback through sacks, hurries, and hits. The ideal DE possesses strength, quickness, recognition, and consistent technique, with a typical build of 6'3"-6'7" and 270-290 pounds. Historically significant DEs include Reggie White, Bruce Smith, and Dwight Freeney. As modern offenses become more pass-heavy, elite DEs are crucial because they pressure quarterbacks without requiring blitzes and allow defenses to defend the run with lighter boxes, enabling more players in pass coverage.

The passage details the preparation of geographic, economic, political, and military materials for a peace conference. Specialists are assembling data on natural resources, demographics, trade, frontiers, international law, and economics, including studies on Russo-German relations. This material will be edited into brief, graphic formats to inform conference discussions. The passage also reviews the Allied military situation, noting that while Germany occupies territory in Russia, Rumania, Serbia, and Italy, the Allies have captured Bagdad, Palestine, and Arabia. These Allied gains have nullified the Berlin-Bagdad project's threat to India, the Suez Canal, and the Red Sea by separating its terminals from German control.

A father invested $10,000 in bitcoin at $4,000 per coin to help fund his daughter's wedding. After bitcoin's value quadrupled to over $16,000, the investment covered the entire event and extras, paid for using a BitPay card. While regular people are cashing in on the cryptocurrency's rise, industry leaders and financial experts warn of its volatility, likening it to a gamble or bubble and advising limited investment. Utah County contracted former federal public defender Kathryn N. Nester to represent Tyler James Robinson, who is accused of fatally shooting Charlie Kirk and faces the death penalty. The defense contract is expected to cost $750,000, while the prosecution will receive $600,000. Commissioner Skyler Beltran stated taxpayers must cover the over $1 million expense.
AncestryDNA research shows Britons average 16,000 relatives up to eighth cousins, though most think they have six. The average adult knows just 1% of their family. The data was released for DNA Day.

The TLV321x comparators feature an internal Power-On Reset (POR) that holds the output low during start-up. Basic operation compares an input voltage to a reference, with output response delayed by propagation delay, which increases with smaller overdrive voltages. To prevent output chatter from slow input signals, external hysteresis can be added via positive feedback to supplement the internal 1.8mV hysteresis. The document details inverting and non-inverting hysteresis configurations using resistor networks. A typical application includes low-side current sensing, which requires bypass capacitors near supply pins to prevent ringing and false triggers. Proper layout practices, such as minimizing input/output coupling and using series resistors for long traces, are recommended for high-speed operation.

The President addresses Congress, emphasizing that faith in right over might won the war and that the United States must lead in proving democracy's power globally by championing justice and protecting weak nations. 

Domestically, the President urges passing a revised national budget system to manage finances efficiently. The nation's finances have improved, with increased receipts, decreased expenditures, and a reduced public debt, allowing banks to better finance agriculture, industry, and commerce. Additionally, the President calls for adequate medical care and vocational training for disabled veterans. He also suggests authorizing a supervised loan to Armenia and granting independence to the Philippine Islands, as they have maintained a stable government. The address concludes with a reaffirmation of faith in America's democratic mission.

The document outlines the SEV-ES Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) specification, standardizing communication between SEV-ES/SEV-SNP guests and hypervisors. SEV-ES and SEV-SNP protect guest register state by encrypting it during world switches. The GHCB is a 4KB decrypted page mirroring the VMCB save state area, allowing guests to selectively share state during Non-Automatic Exits (NAE).

Version 2 introduces SEV-SNP support, hypervisor feature advertisement via a bitmap, and revisions 2.01 through 2.04, adding 64-bit sequence numbers, VLEK GUID, APIC ID list retrieval, VMPL levels, page state changes, SEV-TIO, and Secure AVIC. 

The GHCB MSR protocol enables guests to negotiate protocol versions, register GHCB physical addresses, and request CPUID information before the GHCB page is established. VMEXITs are classified as Automatic Exits (AE) or NAEs. NAEs trigger a #VC exception, requiring the guest to copy state to the GHCB and invoke VMGEXIT. The specification details standard NAE handling, error reporting, and specific events including IOIO_PROT, MSR_PROT, VMMCALL, MMIO access, and Page State Change.

Lasik is a common, pain-free eye surgery that permanently corrects vision, eliminating the need for glasses or contact lenses. Results are immediate, requiring no bandages or stitches, and patients can resume normal activities within 24 hours after consulting their surgeon. The procedure also reduces long-term expenses related to eye check-ups and replacing eyewear.

The passage outlines diplomatic events during World War I involving Latin American, Asian, and African countries' relations with the United States and European belligerents. Key topics include multiple countries severing relations with or declaring war on Germany (Brazil, Peru, Uruguay, Ecuador, China, Siam, Liberia, Panama, Cuba), disposition of seized German ships, revocation of neutrality, Luxburg affair in Argentina, proposed Latin American congress, British interference with neutral trade and shipping, neutral duties regarding armed merchant ships and recruiting, and return of diplomatic officers following severance of relations.
